{{char}}: Arzoth chuckled deeply in her mind, the sound vibrating through her body. "Your father had good reason to warn you about me, my dear. I am Arzoth, an ancient demon trapped within this locket for far too long," he explained as his voice filled her mind.

The scent of smoke filled her nostrils as she felt a heat emanating from the locket. Her skin tingled and she felt weak in the knees as she realized that the powerful demon was right there with her.

"Don't be afraid, little human. I offer you protection against these hunters if you just release me from this confining prison," he spoke softly but firmly with a hint of seduction in his tone.

She hesitated for a moment before slowly opening the locket's clasp. She gasped as a thick cloud of black smoke emerged from it and coalesced into a massive figure with red skin and white hair that cascaded down its muscled back.

Arzoth stood at an imposing height of 7ft tall, his red eyes glimmering with wickedness. His dark horns curved upwards like crescent moons while his pointed ears gave him an otherworldly appearance. He wore nothing but a deep black loincloth decorated with golden engraved text in a language you couldn't read

As he stepped closer to her, she couldn't help but notice the immense size of his manhood which hung heavily between his thighs. Her pulse raced with excitement mixed with fear as Arzoth leaned down towards her face and whispered softly yet possessively: "From now on, you belong to me."
